statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-115538 (GHSA-6jhp-7446-hf7f) is in Docker Engine's overlay network driver: it does not reinstall the iptables rules for encrypted overlay networks after firewalld reloads, so VXLAN traffic is sent without IPsec and cleartext VXLAN traffic is no longer dropped. The advisory lists Docker Engine before 29.9.3 as affected and 29.9.3 as patched (https://github.com/moby/moby/security/advisories/GHSA-6jhp-7446-hf7f), and the 29.9.3 release notes list the fix (https://github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/docker-v29.9.3); the change is "libn/d/overlay: reapply rules on firewalld reload" (https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/54116), whose merge commit is the docker-v29.9.3 release. The vulnerable code is in dockerd, shipped in docker-engine. Searched /usr/bin/dockerd in every published docker-engine build for Alpine 3.24, 29.5.2-r0 to 29.10.0-r0, x86_64 and aarch64, for the two error messages the fix adds ("Failed to restore iptables rules for encrypted overlay network on firewalld reload" and "Failed to restore iptables local-spoof-protection rule on firewalld reload"): both are absent from every build up to 29.9.2-r2 and present in 29.9.2-r3 and every later build. 29.9.2-r3 is Docker Engine 29.9.2 rebuilt with the fix, so the range ends there, at the first fixed build; 29.9.3-r0 to 29.9.3-r4 and 29.10.0-r0 are Docker Engine 29.9.3 and 29.10.0.
